name: The gym (a showcase for the testers, not a level of the game)
about: Javier & Claude, 2026-11-04. Level 4's boss from the team's roster, Coach Crusher, in a plain underground gym: medicine ball, jab, jab, tackle; his big gloves block every punch, so kicks only; step aside from the tackle and he slams into the ropes; dizzy him twice and he gives up. Not in levels.json: level 4 places him.
